slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: It is an easy word to say. Here is what it means in a normal month.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Agents on your machines and servers report disk space, failing drives, missed backups, dropped services and security alerts. Thresholds create a ticket automatically, so the common ones get dealt with before anybody notices, rather than sitting on a dashboard nobody has open.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Operating systems and third-party applications are updated on a defined cadence rather than whenever a user finally clicks the reminder. Unpatched software is still the most common way in, and patch management is one of the five Cyber Essentials controls for exactly that reason.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: We keep a live picture of what you own, how old it is and what it costs. That is how you avoid the two classic wastes: paying for subscriptions nobody uses, and running critical work on a machine that should have been replaced two years ago.
